corpsman-parent-radius.scope: Restore Group charged 18 IS per stock cast. Source 369 stat 1054 +1 removed/re-added at 43/46 memory, with matching 1092 grant transitions in retained-wire checks. QAFriend at 8.60 m healed 27 throughout the parent-only stages and after dismissal.

stats.source: GOB 369 grants 1092 and authors passive stat 1054. The granted upgrade independently authors a direct radius modifier.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the passive and grant across ordinary entry and Archive transitions. The passive and direct totals remain distinct.
stats.test: Restore Group charged 18 IS per stock cast. Source 369 stat 1054 +1 removed/re-added at 43/46 memory, with matching 1092 grant transitions in retained-wire checks. QAFriend at 8.60 m healed 27 throughout the parent-only stages and after dismissal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1055#issuecomment-7122129435

consumer.source: The recovered caster-radius selector reads direct stat 127. The linked owner scale is omitted from the shipped 127 template.
consumer.runtime: Parent-only radius remains 8.68 m. The 1092 direct upgrade changes it to 9.38 m; dismissal restores the base.
consumer.test: QAFar at 8.70 m healed for 28 only under 1092's direct stat 127 +10. QAOther at 9.50 m was excluded throughout. No fixed rolls. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1055#issuecomment-7122129435

behavior-tests.source: The shipped parent is a loaded passive with a zero-rank grant; the direct buff is a separate action.
behavior-tests.runtime: Same-region and valid recipient checks continue to run on every cast at the resulting radius.
behavior-tests.test: The disposable retained-stock replay verifies normal Archive, grant wire transitions, unchanged loaded/unloaded/reloaded recipient sets and the direct-upgrade comparison in combination with the native run. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1055#issuecomment-7122129435
